answer_1.quote: We construct caption queries ... the goal is to generate a textual description (a caption) for a given image ... POPE is designed to evaluate object hallucination in the VQA paradigm.
answer_1.outputs: Generated captions and VQA answers describing image content

answer_2.quote: Evaluation is conducted using accuracy as the primary metric ... average improvement of 13.56% on the POPE benchmark and 21.75% on the hallucination subsets of the MME.
